description: In every PA-model, nonzero recognized formula-depth decomposes its actual code into falsum, equality, implication or universal quantification, with the corresponding valid children.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth_cases.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (e : M)
  (he :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth e ≠
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) :
  e = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 3 [] ∨
    (∃ a b,
        e = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 4 [a, b] ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth a ≠
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth b ≠
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∨
      (∃ a b,
          e = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 6 [a, b] ∧
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth a ≠
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth b ≠
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∨
        ∃ a,
          e = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 7 [a] ∧
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.formDepth a ≠
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
